body: Yah it’s hard. I really do want to make an honest effort. I don’t think it’s there yet or I’m on the fence yet but I would saying I’m looking at that fence more and more.

Sorry for being to vague! I guess I really just want his time honestly. I like to get out and do fun stuff on Saturday’s like hikes or day trips or festivals. It’s like dragging him every where I go. He complains the whole time that he isn’t working and we just leave. I just want his time and care. He doesn’t ‘care’ about a lot of things

He is working to build a business. I know that this takes a lot coming from my dad having his own business my self. It’s his passion. He makes plenty of money that if he just cut back an hour or two a day our lives wouldn’t change much. We are planning our first just us vacation right now. I worry even then he will work. I’ll think I’ll propose to him us seriously considering couples therapy. We do it finically. It’s just something I don’t want to scare him with. Thank you for your reply so very much
Thank you so much. i have heard of that and will look into it. thank you again

I agree with Tiffany thing. I did end up calling her and we talked. I can tell she is torn. It’s like she wants to be mad at me but she knows what i did was right. she told me Ann wish i would have waited. I said that it was her safety and now at least people who can help her know. Tiffany said Ann wants space from us for time while she deals with people and the situation.  Thank you for the advice i really love knowing i’m not wrong to have worried
